title: Fingers fold in familiar patterns until arachnid appendages ascend, then descend on fret board in steady bends clawing through arpeggios #ukulele #sma
summary: Fingers fold in familiar patterns until arachnid appendages ascend, then descend on fret board in steady bends clawing through arpeggios #ukulele #smallpoems about getting fingers to find patterns that always existed
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Fingers fold in
  familiar patterns
until arachnid
appendages
  ascend, then
descend on
fret board in
steady bends
clawing through
arpeggios

#ukulele
#smallpoems about getting fingers to find patterns that always existed
